description.shipper: The standing agreements your loads are filed under: what you committed to, who moves it, and how far along it is.
description.carrier: Your agreements with clients and the shares of theirs allocated to you, and how far along each one is.

search.placeholder: Search by reference, client or company

tiles.attention-hint: Used up, or past their end date
tiles.draft-hint: Not activated yet; no trips can be filed

basis-hint.weight: A tonnage, drawn down by each load's weight
basis-hint.days: A truck for a period, priced by the day

values.open-hint: No fixed quantity: trips are filed while there is cargo, and it is never used up.
values.trips-filed: {count, plural, =0 {No trips yet} one {# trip} other {# trips}}

empty-description.shipper: File the agreements you have with your transporters, split them across the companies that move for you, and every load filed under one draws it down.
empty-description.carrier: File your agreements with clients here. Shares of your clients' contracts allocated to you appear under From partners.

data.error: The contracts could not be loaded

form.description: The terms the loads will be filed under. Everything here is a default the loads can change.

allocation-form.description: Who moves this part of the contract, how much of it, and at what price.

fields.open-hint: No fixed share; the transporter sends trucks while there is cargo.

allocation-form.remove-confirm: Remove this share? Only a share with no trips filed under it can go.

detail.error: This contract could not be loaded

actions.close-confirm: Close this contract? No more trips can be filed under it.

detail.over-allocated: The shares add up to more than the contract commits to.
detail.no-trips: No trips filed under this contract yet.

errors.NOT_FOUND: This contract does not exist, or your company is not on it.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Somebody changed this contract meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_OPEN: Trips can only be filed under an active contract.
errors.CONTRACT_SHAPE_MISMATCH: This share is moved by somebody else; file it as an order.
errors.BASIS_IS_FIXED: What a contract counts cannot change once it exists.
errors.PERIOD_INVERTED: The end date is before the start date.
errors.QUANTITY_REQUIRED: The quantity has to be more than zero.
errors.PRICE_MODEL_BASIS_MISMATCH: That price model cannot price what this contract counts.
errors.CLIENT_IS_SELF: A company cannot be its own client.
errors.CARRIER_IS_SELF: A share for your own fleet is filed as own fleet, not as a transporter.
errors.APPLOAD_NOT_A_CLIENT: Appload moves loads; it does not order them.
errors.NOT_CONNECTED: That company is not connected to yours.
errors.OWN_FLEET_HAS_NO_BUY_PRICE: Your own fleet has no buy price; the contract's price is what the client pays.
errors.RIG_NOT_ON_ALLOCATION: A truck or driver can only be pinned to a company on the portal.
errors.TRUCK_NOT_REGISTERED: That truck is not registered to that company.
errors.DRIVER_NOT_REGISTERED: That driver is not registered to that company.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXISTS: That company already has a share of this contract.
errors.ALLOCATION_HAS_TRIPS: Trips have been filed under this share; it cannot be removed or reassigned.
errors.ALLOCATION_NOT_VISIBLE: That share is not one your company can file under.
errors.INVALID_STATUS: That change is not possible from where the contract is.
